# TeslaMate 数据总览
当前车辆状态、所选时段核心指标、趋势和最近记录集中展示。右上角时间范围会同时作用于行程与充电统计。

[数据总览](/d/be2m9kga7b8qoc/teslamate-home?var-car_id=$car_id&from=$__from&to=$__to) · [实时总览](/d/tmOverviewHubCN/overview-center?var-car_id=$car_id&from=$__from&to=$__to) · [行程与足迹](/d/tmDrivingHubCN/driving-center?var-car_id=$car_id&from=$__from&to=$__to) · [充电与费用](/d/tmChargingHubCN/charging-center?var-car_id=$car_id&from=$__from&to=$__to) · [电池与能效](/d/tmEnergyHubCN/energy-center?var-car_id=$car_id&from=$__from&to=$__to) · [分析与洞察](/d/tmAnalysisHubCN/analysis-center?var-car_id=$car_id&from=$__from&to=$__to) · [系统与数据](/d/tmSystemHubCN/system-center?var-car_id=$car_id&from=$__from&to=$__to)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT state
FROM (
  SELECT start_date, CASE state
    WHEN 'asleep' THEN 'asleep'
    WHEN 'online' THEN 'online'
    WHEN 'offline' THEN 'offline'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS state
  FROM states
  WHERE car_id = $car_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT start_date, 'driving' AS state
  FROM drives
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND end_date IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT start_date, 'charging' AS state
  FROM charging_processes
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND end_date IS NULL
) activity
ORDER BY start_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT battery_level
FROM (
  (SELECT date, battery_level
   FROM positions
   WHERE car_id = $car_id AND battery_level IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT c.date, c.battery_level
   FROM charges c
   JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.id = c.charging_process_id
   WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND c.battery_level IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY c.date DESC LIMIT 1)
) latest
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT convert_km(range_km::numeric, '$length_unit') AS range_$length_unit
FROM (
  (SELECT date, [[preferred_range]]_battery_range_km AS range_km
   FROM positions
   WHERE car_id = $car_id AND [[preferred_range]]_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT c.date, c.[[preferred_range]]_battery_range_km AS range_km
   FROM charges c
   JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.id = c.charging_process_id
   WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND c.[[preferred_range]]_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY c.date DESC LIMIT 1)
) latest
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT convert_km(odometer::numeric, '$length_unit') AS distance_$length_unit
FROM positions
WHERE car_id = $car_id AND odometer IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(
  g.name,
  a.name,
  NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), ''),
  a.city,
  '未知位置'
) AS "位置"
FROM drives d
LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = d.end_address_id
LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = d.end_geofence_id
WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.end_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT split_part(version, ' ', 1) AS "固件版本"
FROM updates
WHERE car_id = $car_id
ORDER BY start_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(tm_effective_cost(id, cost)), 0)::numeric, 2) AS "充电费用"
FROM charging_processes
WHERE car_id = $car_id AND tm_effective_cost(id, cost) IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date);

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', timezone('UTC', start_date), '$__timezone') AS time,
  convert_km(SUM(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') AS distance_$length_unit
FROM drives
WHERE car_id = $car_id AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', timezone('UTC', start_date), '$__timezone') AS time,
  ROUND(SUM(tm_effective_cost(id, cost))::numeric, 2) AS "充电费用"
FROM charging_processes
WHERE car_id = $car_id AND tm_effective_cost(id, cost) IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  d.start_date AS "开始时间",
  COALESCE(sg.name, sa.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', sa.road, sa.house_number), ''), sa.city, '未知地点') AS "起点",
  COALESCE(eg.name, ea.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', ea.road, ea.house_number), ''), ea.city, '未知地点') AS "终点",
  convert_km(d.distance::numeric, '$length_unit') AS distance_$length_unit,
  ROUND(d.duration_min::numeric, 0) AS "时长（分钟）",
  convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit') AS speed_$length_unit
FROM drives d
LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
LEFT JOIN geofences sg ON sg.id = d.start_geofence_id
LEFT JOIN geofences eg ON eg.id = d.end_geofence_id
WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
ORDER BY d.start_date DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  cp.start_date AS "开始时间",
  COALESCE(g.name, a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), ''), a.city, '未知地点') AS "充电地点",
  cp.start_battery_level AS "开始电量",
  cp.end_battery_level AS "结束电量",
  ROUND(cp.charge_energy_added::numeric, 1) AS "充入电量（千瓦时）",
  ROUND(tm_effective_cost(cp.id, cp.cost)::numeric, 2) AS "费用（元）",
  ROUND(cp.duration_min::numeric, 0) AS "时长（分钟）"
FROM charging_processes cp
LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date)
ORDER BY cp.start_date DESC
LIMIT 10;

options.content: > 数值为 0 通常表示所选时段没有符合条件的记录。可扩大右上角时间范围；多车用户请先确认“车辆”选择。现有用户若仍跳到“行程”，请在个人偏好中把主仪表板改为“首页”。

SELECT
    id as __value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(id) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND name IS NOT NULL
      THEN CONCAT(name, ' - ', RIGHT(vin, 6))
      ELSE COALESCE(name, CONCAT('VIN ', vin))
    END as __text
FROM cars
ORDER BY display_priority ASC, name ASC, vin ASC;
